title: A delegation spawned with "/review-code -- <note>" is refused as a native slash command when the cwd is the parent's own workdir, though the same command takes the note from any other cwd
outcome: One project command file resolves to the same kind for a delegation spawn whatever the cwd. So "/review-code -- <note>" either works everywhere or is refused everywhere with a reason that names the file, and a spawn without an explicit cwd says which workdir its children will run in.
acceptance: A delegation spawned with "/review-code -- <note>" is refused as a native slash command when the cwd is the parent's own workdir, though the same command takes the note from any other cwd is done
